about_the_game:
Start as a broke and humiliated janitor, living in a women's dormitory.

Plan and optimize your day-to-day activities throughout the week, like Persona games, but filled with vanilla femdom. Grind and strategize your way through them, or surrender your fate into their hands!

Find various ways to exploit your position. Learn what goes on inside a girls' dorm and discover many secrets as you go through your day-to-day life full of humiliation and frustration.

Interact with characters full of personalities and take part in their kinkiest requests. Endure and manage your days while keeping track of the things around you. Explore and uncover dirty and dark mysteries, and decide which goals to pursue.

With fun and short dialogues and texts, enjoy a punchy premise. It's recommended that you don't skip them, as they may give clues about what's possible and impact your overall experience.

Spy on the girls without getting caught. Learn about their nature and motivate them to do nasty things, whether by slipping a lewd comic into the living room or replacing their vibrators. Buy various items to aid your schemes and establish a profitable business by selling pictures, recordings, panties, milk, etc.

Blackmail the girls or simply leak their nudes after you jerk off. Blackmail someone too much, and she might leave the dorm for good. But new girls will move in if there's a vacancy!

While engaging in devious acts, maintain a low suspicion level and pay your rent as you progress toward an ending. Depending on your choices, you may branch out to different routes leading to dark, fulfilling, or secret endings.

Hidden variables and switches may keep track of what you do and reflect the game based on your behavior. There is also a bit of randomness involved to keep each playthrough fresh.

Experience an old-school RPG with modern retro pixel art!
